events.summary: Gaya deleted 32 PR lines on 15 Oct, after the RFQ had gone out on all of them. I'll see what the enquiry cost and what can still be saved.
Site requirement planner: the PR lines and why they were closed.

All 32 lines of PRs 1000203559, 1000203669 and 1000203718 were deleted the day after the project head's mail; his reasons are the client's design approval, the SIP, the look-ahead under approval and cash flow. None of them is SCM's.

The cancellation should be on record with Projects' approval and reason, so the spent enquiry is theirs; asking the vendors to hold their quotes costs nothing and is worth starting beside it.
Buyer's clerk: the note to the Gaya project head.
